text: THE FIGMA `List Row` AND `Card` MASTERS HOLD TOGETHER AT A PHONE'S WIDTH. A List Row made 327 wide crushed its trailing slot to one letter per line and stood 444px tall, because the row could not wrap and the slot was fixed at 5px; the code wraps it by flex alone. All 9 variants now reproduce that with auto-layout (WRAP, the line gap bound to `stack/12`, a 224 minimum on the text column, the row aligned to its end) and, measured against the build, the slot drops 12 below the text and keeps 16 from the right edge exactly as the portal does at 375, while staying inline at desktop width. No variant was added, because the code has no phone breakpoint to mirror. A Card could not be made fluid either: two inner frames were stamped at 369, wider than a 327 card and hidden only by clipping. They now fill, and a Vertical card at 327 has nothing wider than itself. Every master is unchanged at its own size. A narrow `Table` was deliberately not built — the portal draws no table below 768px, and `Worklist / Card` is its phone form
